name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + dialog domain + descriptor. Accurately names the read-only template that drives the dialog box page-advance/collapse fold animation. No Ghidra address residue. The 'collapse' descriptor matches the primary reader fd2_animate_dialog_page_advance_collapse; the second reader (typewriter intro fold-out) is the mirror of the same animation, so the name remains representative.
purpose: Read-only 4-int const template supplying the two corner-box sprite SELECTOR indices (0x10 = left corner box, 0x11 = right corner box) for the dialog box's 4-frame fold (collapse / expand) animation. Stored as two identical int32 pairs so each of the two consumers block-copies its own pair into a local stack frame.
logic_summary: Each consumer does 'MOV ESI,<addr>; MOVSD; MOVSD' to copy two int32s into the first two dwords of a local 4-dword corner-state frame: corner_state[0]=left selector, corner_state[1]=right selector; corner_state[2],[3] are the animated corner offsets (initialized in code to +/-16, ramped per frame toward/away from center -- NOT from this table). The two selectors are used as table indices: corner_state[i]*0xC (or *3 in the typewriter main loop) indexes the menu_dialog_state_handle sprite-pointer table to fetch the corner-box sprite, which is blitted at (yes_no_box_addr + corner_state[i+2]). fd2_animate_dialog_page_advance_collapse @ 0x197F8/0x197FD reads slots [0],[1] from 0x51EE5; fd2_text_dialog_typewriter_loop @ 0x19966/0x1996B reads slots [2],[3] from 0x51EED. Verified by disassembly: ESI=0x51ee5 then 2x MOVSD in reader 1; ESI=0x51eed then 2x MOVSD in reader 2.
element_semantics: [0]=0x10 left-corner box sprite selector, [1]=0x11 right-corner box sprite selector (reader-1 copy); [2]=0x10 left-corner selector, [3]=0x11 right-corner selector (reader-2 copy). Each value is a selector index into the dialog-state-handle sprite-pointer table (multiplied by 0xC or 3), not a pixel coordinate.
comment_original_issue: src comment described the elements as 'Left-corner sprite-coordinate base values ... used as a signed int in sprite-blit address arithmetic', which is incorrect: the values are corner-box sprite SELECTOR indices (multiplied *0xC / *3 to index the menu_dialog_state_handle sprite-pointer table), not coordinates; the actual blit-address offsets (+/-16) are the separate in-code-initialized corner-state dwords [2],[3], not entries of this table. The two-reader split ([0],[1] via MOVSD from 0x51EE5; [2],[3] via MOVSD from 0x51EED) was correct and retained.
notes: Both readers use the values purely as corner-box sprite selectors; the down-arrow 'page-complete press-to-advance flashing icon' claim in the prior Ghidra plate was an unverified embellishment and was removed (no evidence in disasm). is_const=true: all xrefs are READ/DATA, zero writers. Ghidra plate had non-ASCII (down-arrow glyph) and stale emit_action metadata, plus the superseded plate text living in a PRE comment; plate rewritten as ASCII PLATE_COMMENT and stale PRE comment cleared. Ghidra program saved.
